scope: All registered independent numerical benchmarks, native public request/result boundary, persisted result decoder and acceptance report. No online AI, performance or clean Windows acceptance.
referencePolicy: Keep all original independent reference values and pass limits. Native versus TypeScript agreement is regression evidence only. Never use product mechanics or modal vectors as the analytical oracle.
errorPolicy: Retain each original max(abs,rel*reference) or abs+rel*reference bound. Record absolute error in the quantity unit, relative error only outside the registered near-zero floor. PSD curve errors are normalized by the reference peak, not zero point values. Recompute numeric decisions; upstream passed flags cannot override them.
convergencePolicy: Separate mesh refinement, modal truncation/extraction, frequency-curve refinement and variance/RMS integration. Require at least two increasing resolutions and actual finite measurements in each category. Retain deliberate budget-exhausted states as such; modal/static unconverged results are never counted as converged samples.
failurePolicy: A child failure, timeout, missing/empty artifact, false-success numeric check, nonfinite quantity, missing convergence category or failed guard makes the command exit nonzero. Run all remaining independent suites and publish failed evidence. Never fall back to old task evidence.

suites.coverage: Full 22-case static regression: spatial frame, axes, distributed loads, self-weight and combinations; equilibrium and actual process residuals; 7 invalid models and raw protocol failures.
Five idealized section reference property tables and 15 rotated analytical cantilevers.
Original catalog property transcriptions and legacy property-section compatibility.
All 16 end-release combinations and portal; residual DOF units distinguish forces and moments.
Internal subdivision and engineering-object mapping; analytical midpoint deflection, mesh histories, equilibrium, mechanism and budgets.
Continuum cantilever/pinned/fixed frequencies and shapes, mass-normalized residuals, arbitrary sign and four-dimensional repeated-root subspace.
Independent tip-mass boundary determinant, uniform line mass, mass balance, self-weight separation and released mass coordinates.
Uniform/per-mode damping and modal sufficiency; damping response independently checked by T2-33.
Euler column and portal, fixed preload not scaled, shape sign/normalization, repeated-root subspace, actual eigen residuals and instability failures.
Continuous tan/tanh column and independent RK4 variable-axial-force reference, portal, mesh convergence, actual correction residuals, instability and nonconvergence.
20 continuous analytical modes, scalar oscillator, damping, narrow peak, antiresonance, piecewise spectrum, modal/frequency/integration budgets.
Analytical spatial integrals, same-source coherence/cancellation and independent-source PSD summation.
Continuous whole-base participation, tip-mass SDOF limit, force/base independence, PSD unit conversion, modal extraction comparison.
Five methods reject nonfinite and incomplete saved success records; native invalid/overflow requests publish error diagnostics and no successful result.
